text_block_list.name: Sirius's Junior
text_block_list.text: Somebody heeeelp!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On a pleasant, sunny afternoon... One of 
Sirius Symboli's juniors rushed into the 
trainer's office, pale with panic.

text_block_list.name: Sirius's Junior
text_block_list.text:
My girls are at each other's throats, 
sparks are flying! J-J-Just please, get 
over here now!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Sensing that something serious was amiss, 
the two of us headed toward the place our 
junior was leading us to—

text_block_list.name: Bespectacled Sirius Underclassman
text_block_list.text:
L-I-K-E I S-A-I-D! Sirius-san's 
amazingness comes from her brilliant 
brain!

text_block_list.name: Short-Haired Sirius Underclassman
text_block_list.text:
I told you that's not it! Sirius-senpai is 
amazing because her motor skills are 
genuinely insane!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her underclassmen were arguing over what 
made Sirius Symboli so amazing.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: ...What a load of crap.

text_block_list.name: Bespectacled Sirius Underclassman
text_block_list.text:
It is NOT stupid! —Are you listening? I'm 
going to say it one more time!

text_block_list.name: Bespectacled Sirius Underclassman
text_block_list.text:
Of course, she can basically do anything! 
Can't you tell from the way Senpai speaks? 
Her memory and adaptability back up an 
extraordinary wealth of knowledge!

text_block_list.name: Bespectacled Sirius Underclassman
text_block_list.text:
"That's precisely why she's always cool 
and deeply self-disciplined, calmly 
analyzing the flow of the race to snatch 
victory!"

text_block_list.name: Short-Haired Sirius Underclassman
text_block_list.text:
Haaah?! Don't you get it? It's not just 
that she's athletic. She can copy anything 
after seeing it once, her dynamic visual 
acuity is insane, and—

text_block_list.name: Short-Haired Sirius Underclassman
text_block_list.text:
Above all, that fierce competitiveness 
backed by genius athleticism! That's why 
the competition cowers, and why Senpai can 
snatch victory so spectacularly!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: We're going back.

text_block_list.name: Sirius's Junior
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, whoa, whoa, wait a second! If a 
fistfight starts, there's no way I can 
stop it—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Whether hearing those screams or not... 
the bespectacled junior grabbed the 
short-haired junior by the collar!

text_block_list.name: Bespectacled Sirius Underclassman
text_block_list.text:
If words won't get through to you, my 
fists definitely will?!

text_block_list.name: Short-Haired Sirius Underclassman
text_block_list.text:
Aah!? You've got some nerve, let's do 
this!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: —Tch. Hey.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Personally, I couldn't care less, but if 
you're that curious, I'll settle it once 
and for all.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Puppy. You can do it, can't ya? Be the 
judge.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Though perplexed... I wonder what Sirius 
Symboli excels at most, and—

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
... Didn't you say to make things black 
and white?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
If you're gonna show up as a third 
faction, show some damn proof. This'll 
never end otherwise.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It's no lie that I feel Sirius Symboli 
possesses both.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As "evidence," I show the juniors the mock 
race video we recorded the other day.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Using those keen wits to calmly read the 
flow of the race, she snatched victory 
from behind at a precise moment that would 
be impossible without sheer physical 
talent—

text_block_list.name: Sirius's Juniors
text_block_list.text: I-Incredible! S-So awesome!
choice_data_list:
It's a feat you can't pull off unless you 
possess both.

It's a feat you can't pull off unless you 
possess both.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And with that, I carefully explained the 
flow of the race and why Sirius Symboli 
was able to win.

text_block_list.name: Bespectacled Sirius Underclassman
text_block_list.text:
...I see. I'm sorry, maybe I didn't quite 
understand.

text_block_list.name: Short-Haired Sirius Underclassman
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry too. I might have unconsciously 
been filtering things...

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
—Is it settled, then? Don't you ever start 
stupid fights like that again.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Still... you managed to handle things 
pretty damn well yourself, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Sirius Symboli heads back, humming a tune 
under her breath. ...It seemed I managed 
to give a decent answer.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
... Didn't you say to make things black 
and white?

text_block_list.name: Short-Haired Sirius Underclassman
text_block_list.text:
Ah, you ain't gettin' cold feet on me now, 
are ya!?
choice_data_list: No, that's not what I meant—

text_block_list.name: Bespectacled Sirius Underclassman
text_block_list.text:
Hey, there's no way Sirius-san's Trainer 
would do something so petty! That's rude, 
apologize!

text_block_list.name: Short-Haired Sirius Underclassman
text_block_list.text: Why are you acting so high and mighty?!

text_block_list.name: Bespectacled Sirius Underclassman
text_block_list.text:
Huh? I'm not acting high and mighty at 
all, I'm just stating the obvious.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Answering "Both" turned out to be an 
unexpected spark, escalating the argument 
in a bizarre direction—

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Shut up, shut up, shut up, shut UP! You're 
so noisy!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
...Good grief. Never bring that topic up 
again. It's utterly pointless. 
—Understood?

text_block_list.name: Sirius's Juniors
text_block_list.text: ...Yeees.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to Sirius Symboli, things calmed 
down, but... I was left with a faint sense 
of regret, wishing I had answered better.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Oh? Brains, huh.

text_block_list.name: Bespectacled Sirius Underclassman
text_block_list.text:
As expected of Sirius-san's Trainer! You 
understand her so well!

text_block_list.name: Short-Haired Sirius Underclassman
text_block_list.text: B-But—

text_block_list.name: Bespectacled Sirius Underclassman
text_block_list.text:
It's common knowledge! Come to think of 
it, Maruzen-san, your classmate, was 
saying the same thing before, Senior!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
She never takes notes, you know. Why do 
you think that is?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"Because you can just look at the textbook 
and understand it," she said. Ehehe, isn't 
that so cool~?!

text_block_list.name: Bespectacled Sirius Underclassman
text_block_list.text: ...Right?! Isn't that so, Sirius-san!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
...I just said I don't get why you can't 
understand it without taking notes.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Forget about that, the verdict is in. Cut 
out the stupid bickering, all of you.

text_block_list.name: Sirius's Juniors
text_block_list.text: Okaaay. ...Siiigh.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
...Still, to think even you'd hold this 
big brain of mine in such high regard, 
huh?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
"I'll deliver an intellectual and clever 
race for you, to keep living up to your 
expectations."

text_block_list.name: Short-Haired Sirius Underclassman
text_block_list.text:
Wha! Are you serious?! How can you call 
yourself a Trainer and not know that?!

text_block_list.name: Short-Haired Sirius Underclassman
text_block_list.text:
Sirius-senpai's genius athleticism! That's 
the reason why she—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (SNAP!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The one who delivered a fierce forehead 
flick to the trembling, short-haired 
junior was Sirius Symboli.

text_block_list.name: Short-Haired Sirius Underclassman
text_block_list.text: Guh...!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Quiet. This is the judgment I have handed 
down. Accept it in silence.

text_block_list.name: Short-Haired Sirius Underclassman
text_block_list.text: Excuse me~...

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Good grief...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Although things were somehow smoothed 
over... Sirius Symboli headed home with a 
heavy sigh.

text_block_list.name: Short-Haired Sirius Underclassman
text_block_list.text:
Right on! That's Sirius-senpai's Trainer 
for you!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
...Well, in terms of sheer physical 
capability, it's not theoretically wrong.

text_block_list.name: Bespectacled Sirius Underclassman
text_block_list.text: Huh? Theoretically speaking?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Lend me a hand. —Listen to the sound.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Sirius Symboli took the hands of the two 
juniors and placed them over the right 
side of her chest— right where her heart 
was.

text_block_list.name: Bespectacled Sirius Underclassman
text_block_list.text:
"...Huh? This heartbeat feels incredibly 
powerful..."

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
I've had a reputation for having strong 
nerves since way back. It's come in pretty 
handy.

text_block_list.name: Bespectacled Sirius Underclassman
text_block_list.text:
I see, so that's why. The reason 
Sirius-san is so strong—

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Man, are you stupid? That's not the only 
reason. Strength is made up of a bunch of 
different things.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Every last one of you thinking so 
short-sightedly. If you wanna look up at 
me, keep your eyes firmly on *me*. 
Understood?

text_block_list.name: Sirius's Juniors
text_block_list.text: Yes...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Sirius Symboli gently gave the crestfallen 
juniors a soft tap on the head.

text_block_list.name: Bespectacled Sirius Underclassman
text_block_list.text:
Wha! You're Sirius-san's Trainer, and you 
don't even know that!?

text_block_list.name: Bespectacled Sirius Underclassman
text_block_list.text:
Without a keen intellect, Sirius's victory 
would be impossible—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (SNAP!)

text_block_list.name: Bespectacled Sirius Underclassman
text_block_list.text: Ouch!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The one who delivered a fierce finger-snap 
to the enraged, bespectacled junior was 
none other than Sirius Symboli.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
"Quit your yapping, you're annoying. The 
call's been made, so deal with it."

text_block_list.name: Bespectacled Sirius Underclassman
text_block_list.text: Aye...

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
"...And furthermore, you are never to 
argue over such stupid crap ever again."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Although things were somehow smoothed 
over... Sirius Symboli headed home with a 
heavy sigh.
